installedObservation.scope: Installed and enabled state only; complete third-party workflows not tested

limitations: Named third-party add-on workflows are not integrated into the native suite.
Reading Mode tests use controlled primary state flags and iframe visibility in the real PDF reader; full SDT Reading Mode UI is not tested.
Windows and Linux native runtime tests have not been run.
The copy handler check uses a synthetic event rather than the shared operating-system clipboard.
